nomi_nel_db: IN-0006 Advanced Micro Devices | IN-1249 AMD
domanda: Are 'Advanced Micro Devices' (ticker AMD, Nasdaq) and 'AMD' the same company? Answer yes or no first, then give the evidence.
risposta_exa: Yes. Advanced Micro Devices, Inc. and AMD are the same company [1][2]. Advanced Micro Devices, Inc. is the official legal name of the corporation, while AMD serves as its commonly used name, trade name, and the stock ticker symbol under which it is listed on the Nasdaq Stock Exchange [1][2][3]. Corporate filings and official documentation consistently use the terms interchangeably to refer to the same entity and its consolidated subsidiaries [2][4].
nota: Advanced Micro Devices e AMD sono la stessa societa (nome esteso e abbreviato). Fonti Exa: sito investor AMD e filing SEC (aperte da Exa, non da me). Vincitore atteso IN-1249 (QID, Crunchbase, 3 relazioni).

nomi_nel_db: IN-0242 MP Materials Class A | IN-1311 MP Materials
domanda: Are 'MP Materials Class A' (ticker MP, NYSE) and 'MP Materials' the same company? Answer yes or no first, then give the evidence.
risposta_exa: Yes. MP Materials Corp. is the formal legal name of the company that trades under the ticker symbol MP on the New York Stock Exchange [1][2]. While initial filings in 2020 referenced Class A common stock [1], recent SEC filings refer to the company's publicly traded securities simply as common stock, with both the registrant and the entity commonly referred to as MP Materials [2][3]. The terms are used interchangeably in official company reporting to describe the same business entity [2][4].

domanda: Are 'Business Machines' (ticker IBM) and 'IBM' (International Business Machines) the same company? Answer yes or no first, then give the evidence.
risposta_exa: Yes. International Business Machines Corporation is the legal name of the company that uses the ticker symbol IBM [1][2][3]. Originally incorporated in 1911 as the Computing-Tabulating-Recording Co., the organization adopted the name International Business Machines Corporation in 1924 and continues to trade under the symbol IBM on the New York Stock Exchange [1][2][4].
nota: Stessa societa (IBM). Attenzione: due profili Crunchbase diversi (business-machines su IN-0062, ibm su IN-1294) da non perdere in silenzio; il nome vincitore va corretto in IBM. Fonti non riaperte da me.

nomi_nel_db: IN-0803 Iveco Defence Vehicles | IN-1431 Idv Defence Vehicles Italia
domanda: Are 'Iveco Defence Vehicles' (IDV, website idvgroup.com) and 'Idv Defence Vehicles Italia' the same legal entity, or is one a subsidiary or a renamed version of the other? Answer first, then give the evidence.
risposta_exa: They are the same legal entity. IDV Defence Vehicles Italia S.p.A. is the current legal name of the company formerly known as Iveco Defence Vehicles S.p.A. The name change became effective on January 28, 2026 [1]. Following the acquisition of the defence business from Iveco Group by Leonardo S.p.A., the company continues to operate as a subsidiary of Leonardo [2][3]. The entity retains the same registration number and headquarters in Bolzano, Italy [4][5].

nomi_nel_db: IN-0282 Palantir Technologies Class A | IN-1318 Palantir Technologies
domanda: Are 'Palantir Technologies Class A' (ticker PLTR) and 'Palantir Technologies' the same company? Answer yes or no first, then give the evidence.
risposta_exa: Yes. Palantir Technologies Inc. is the company, and its Class A common stock is a specific equity class issued by that company which trades on the Nasdaq under the ticker symbol PLTR [1][2][3]. SEC filings consistently identify Palantir Technologies Inc. as the registrant and confirm that its Class A common stock is merely one of multiple classes of stock, alongside Class B and Class F, issued by the same entity [1][4][3].

nomi_nel_db: IN-0017 Alphabet Class A | IN-0018 Alphabet Class C | IN-1247 Alphabet
domanda: Are 'Alphabet Class A' (GOOGL), 'Alphabet Class C' (GOOG) and 'Alphabet' the same company issuing different share classes? Answer first, then give the evidence.
risposta_exa: Yes, Alphabet Inc. is the parent company that issues these different share classes [1][2].  Alphabet Inc. maintains three authorized classes of stock, which are identical except for their voting rights [3][4][2]. Class A shares (GOOGL) carry one vote per share, while Class C shares (GOOG) have no voting rights [3][5][2]. A third class, Class B, holds 10 votes per share and is not publicly listed [3][5][2]. These share classes represent equity in the same company, Alphabet Inc., which was established as a holding company to succeed Google Inc. in 2015 [1][2].
nota: Stessa societa con piu classi (GOOGL, GOOG, B non quotata). Regola unica sulle classi: IN-0017 e IN-0018 verso la madre IN-1247. La Class B del SEC e la classe non quotata, non la C di GOOG. Fonti Exa non riaperte da me.

nomi_nel_db: IN-0365 Telecom Italia | IN-0366 Telecom Italia S.p.a
domanda: Are 'Telecom Italia' (ticker TIT, ordinary shares) and 'Telecom Italia S.p.a' (ticker TITR, savings shares) the same company issuing two share classes? Answer first, then give the evidence.
risposta_exa: Yes, they are the same company. Telecom Italia S.p.A. (also known as TIM S.p.A.) is a single entity that historically issued two distinct classes of equity to its shareholders: ordinary shares and savings shares [1][2]. These two classes represented different sets of rights within the same corporation [1][3]. As of May 21, 2026, the company completed the mandatory conversion of all outstanding savings shares into ordinary shares, effectively unifying the share capital structure into a single class of ordinary shares [3][4].
nota: Stessa societa. Pagina TIM: il 21/05/2026 conversione delle azioni di risparmio in ordinarie (6.027.791.699 emesse), capitale ora solo ordinarie; il 15/06/2026 raggruppamento 1 su 10 con nuovo ISIN. Una sola classe, quindi non dipende dalla regola sulle classi. Il ticker TITR resta nello storico iShares. PDF della proposta non leggibile.

domanda: Fincantieri is an Italian shipbuilder. Is there a separate legal entity named 'Fincantieri' that acts as an investor or fund, or is it the same shipbuilding company? Answer first, then give the evidence.
risposta_exa: No, there is not a separate entity named Fincantieri that acts as an investor fund. Fincantieri S.p.A. is a single Italian shipbuilding company [1][2].  While it is a publicly traded company listed on the Borsa Italiana [1][2], its core business is the design and construction of cruise, naval, and offshore vessels [2][3]. The company’s by-laws permit it to hold shares or investments in other companies to support its industrial activities [4][5], but it operates as a manufacturing and engineering group rather than an investment fund [2][3]. It is itself a portfolio company, primarily owned by CDP Equity S.p.A. [6][2].

nomi_nel_db: IN-1290 HII Mission Technologies | IN-1375 Huntington Ingalls Industries
domanda: Is 'HII Mission Technologies' the same legal entity as Huntington Ingalls Industries (HII), or a separate subsidiary or division of it? Answer first, then give the evidence.
risposta_exa: HII Mission Technologies Corp. is a separate legal subsidiary of Huntington Ingalls Industries, Inc. (HII), not the same entity [1][2].  HII is the parent company organized into three reportable operating segments: Ingalls Shipbuilding, Newport News Shipbuilding, and Mission Technologies [3][4]. Mission Technologies is a division of the broader company [5][4], while HII Mission Technologies Corp. is one of many specific legal entities and subsidiary guarantors owned by HII [3][1]. The subsidiary HII Mission Technologies Corp. was formed following a 2022 reorganization involving other HII entities [6].
nota: Non e un duplicato: HII Mission Technologies Corp. (Delaware) e controllata distinta di Huntington Ingalls (Exhibit 21.1 del 10-K 2025, letto). IN-1290 ha il QID della madre Q7257522: da togliere con qid_removed.

domanda: Is 'Alcoa Warrick' (Warrick Operations, Indiana) the same legal entity as Alcoa Corporation, or a separate site, subsidiary or operation of it? Answer first, then give the evidence.
risposta_exa: Alcoa Warrick is not a separate legal entity; it is the name used for the integrated facility and operations managed by Alcoa Corporation subsidiaries [1]. The Alcoa Warrick complex consists of two primary operations, each owned by a distinct subsidiary of Alcoa Corporation: Warrick Newco LLC, which operates the aluminum smelter, and Alcoa Power Generating Inc., which operates the coal-fired power plant [1][2]. These two subsidiaries are managed collectively as Alcoa Warrick Operations [1]. Previously, Alcoa Warrick LLC also held the rolling mill, but that entity and its assets were sold to Kaiser Aluminum Corporation in 2021 [3][4].
nota: Non e un duplicato di Alcoa Corporation. Alcoa Warrick LLC (Delaware) e una controllata (Exhibit 21 del 2016; comunicato Alcoa 2021: laminatoio detenuto da Alcoa Warrick LLC, venduto a Kaiser). Correzione: la risposta di Exa diceva che non era una societa autonoma, la fonte dice il contrario. Nessuna azione sul database.
